title: Business Silver Rewards Card: Annual Fee and Fee Waiver Options
summary: Covers the Business Silver Rewards Card standard annual fee ($122.50) and the first-year annual fee waiver for new customers ($0). It explains how to confirm fee status via the cardholder agreement/disclosures, and by checking the first statement, or contacting support with account details.
